notes: CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5808 LANDED). Every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure is asked, in BindStatement, whether the emitter-verified store classification (BoundStores.StoresInto) stores into a storage-related item of any report's control data item: SameStorageLine is the item, a group containing it, an item subordinate to it, or an item that shares a byte with it through a REDEFINES or RENAMES (the layout's StorageExtent overlap, the same relation ReportSectionBinder.ControlDataReferenceOf asks of SR5 of the 1985 SOURCE rule; a table is every occurrence; an unprovable extent is not asked). COBOL2378, one diagnostic per store, citing the edition's own rule. A BY REFERENCE CALL argument / INVOKE write-back is not counted: whether the callee alters it is not decidable from the source element.
